steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We start by understanding your space, your ideas and how you want to live with the aquarium.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: The concept takes shape: layout, style, materials and equipment, refined together.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: The tank, hardscape and systems are prepared for their new home.

steps.title: Installation
steps.text: The aquarium is brought into your space and set up, ready to become part of it.

steps.title: Maintenance
steps.text: Regular care keeps the aquarium healthy and beautiful long after installation day.
